newsitem.title: UK: EVC full yr capex to rise to dfl 200 mln.
newsitem.headline: EVC full yr capex to rise to dfl 200 mln.

text.p: PVC producer EVC said its capital expenditure is set to rise to an annual 200 million guilders this year and next, mainly due to restructuring costs.
As announced earlier, the company will rejuvenate its Runcorn factory in Britain, while closing plants in both the north west of England as well as on Sardinia in Italy.
These and other restucturing moves will gradually add about 70 million guilders to pre-tax profits from the end of 1998, finance director Nigel Taylor told journalists at a news conference here.
EVC said demand for PVC had been unseasonably high during the summer months, leading to higher prices.
But with prices for other plastics coming back at the same time, Taylor said he was wary whether current PVC price levels could be sustained over a longer period.
EVC earlier reported it swung back in the black with a first-half net profit of 17.0 million guilders after a 7.8 million guilder loss a year ago.
